name: California 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club, SPIN club or camp run by your county. You start with one project from the ones your club offers, and you can sign up for county and state events, webinars and conferences.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 5 to 18 by December 31 of the 4-H year, anywhere in California. You join through your county UC Cooperative Extension 4-H office.
pay_detail: Unpaid. There is an enrollment fee set by your county, and some projects cost extra for supplies. Fee waivers are available: ask your county 4-H contact.
duration: The 4-H year runs July to June. Membership renews each July.
deadline_text: Join any time of year. To show an animal at a county fair, you must enroll by that fair's deadline.
how_to_apply: Find your county 4-H office on the Join page, or fill out the 4-H Interest Form. A parent or guardian makes a household account in ZSuite (or turns in paper forms), signs the health form, and pays the county fee. The county office then turns on your membership.
notes: Read in a browser on 2026-10-16 (scripts get a 403 and a bot check). The old address ucanr.edu/sites/ca4H now goes to the new program page. Fees and which projects are offered depend on your county. State 4-H office: 530-750-1334, ca4H@ucanr.edu.
